pr_title: Set default box size to (2.0, 2.0, 2.0) on box collider when importing
pr_body:
Makes sure to set the importer box collider size to (2.0, 2.0, 2.0) if no option is found, which fixes a bug where the box collider would actually come in at its internal default size, which is still (1.0, 1.0, 1.0)

Closes #58289
pr_comments: Where is the (2.0, 2.0, 2.0) value coming from? Shouldn't that be changed to (1.0, 1.0, 1.0)?
This may have been a recent change, I think we need to track down which PR it was, but I'm assuming it was to change the way box extents are calculated.
Godot 4.0 is replacing the notion of half-extents (`extents` property, akin to a radius) with size property (akin to a diameter).

issue_context.title: Default box collision import size does not match
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

887d4bd0d985979d6c3fb33b053ce99486879956

### System information

Windows 10, Vulkan, Intel® Core™ i7-8700K, Nvidia GTX 1080 (471.11)

### Issue description

When choosing to import meshes with box primitive colliders, using the default size (2.0, 2.0, 2.0) will result in the box being half the size it is, specifically (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), since this is still the default box size.

### Steps to reproduce

Import any mesh and select box as the physics shape type.  When the size is set to (2.0, 2.0, 2.0), it will actually come in at half the size until you change it to anything other than that.

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_

review_comments:
Maybe set the default at https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/45d5aa5d47b2a54c8a2bd50ef95b6a3151bfa24e/scene/resources/box_shape_3d.cpp#L93?

It's a bit strange that the colliders are not box sized.
